machine_type.description: The emulated MIPS machine type. Common values include 'malta', 'mipssim', 'magnum'.

accel.description: The accelerator to use. Options: kvm, xen, tcg. Default is tcg (software emulation).

smp_cpus.description: Number of virtual CPUs to emulate.

ram_size.description: Amount of RAM in MB for the guest.

blockdev_0_driver.description: The block driver format for the disk (e.g., qcow2, raw).

blockdev_0_node_name.description: Unique node name for the block device.

blockdev_0_filename.description: Path to the disk image file on the host.

nics.description: List of network interface configurations for the guest MIPS system. Items are flat maps with netdev_type, id, and optional specific properties.

kernel_args.description: Command line arguments passed to the Linux kernel.

kernel_path.description: Path to the Linux kernel image for MIPS.

initrd_path.description: Path to the initial RAM disk (initrd). Empty string if not used.

dtb_path.description: Path to the Device Tree Blob (DTB) for the machine. Empty string if not used.
